Premium is the paired recompute difference against \texttt{prefix\_stable} with a session-cluster bootstrap interval. Cluster-robust slope of the premium on the number of \texttt{INDEX} rows: $7.40$ tokens per row (SE 0.11, $p=3.55\times10^{-24}$), intercept $21.1$ (SE 0.18), over 1,380 observations (3 index sizes $\times$ 460 paired turns) in 20 sessions; the fitted line is within $11.4$ tokens of every measured level. Inference basis: the same regression with a session-clustered sandwich covariance, $t$ on 19 df; the $[7.19,7.62]$ interval the introduction quotes for the slope is the Wald $\pm1.96$ SE of this fit, whereas the premium intervals in the columns are $2.5$/$97.5$ percentile session-cluster bootstraps.
